items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I heard Louie and him record... Sidney was something else for that... Even Louie Armstrong, as big as Chicago is... he didn't make it a real stamp until he came to New York

ctx.x: And was he on a Bechet kick on soprano?

Well, n-, here's what he said to himself, 'I got my', got his inspiration from - I think I said that before - he got his inspiration from Sidney Bechet. But I thought that Johnny's tone was more cultivated than Sidney's. I thought that Sidney's vibrato was a little bit wide, shaky, wherein Johnny's was smooth. And that's the type of soprano I was playing also. But the ideas that he had, you could detect Sidney, you see? Certain things in his choruses, you know. Perfect. What I'm gettin' at, what I really gettin'…
